messages:
eva-finance: Heads-up — Nebula Analytics (acct NA-778) showing overdue INV-2026-221 for $45,600. Dunning 1-3 sent; last bounce. Need decision on payment plan vs suspension. @diane-am @anjali-collections

marco-cs: Chatted with their CTO. Fundraise slipped; they asked to keep Dedicated live. Proposed 4-month ramp: $15k now, then 3x $10.2k. Asked if we can waive interest/penalties.

diane-am: Confirming client proposal: wire $15k immediately, installments on 2026-04-15, 2026-05-15, 2026-06-15. They want no throttle on public APIs.

anjali-collections: We can accept a plan but require: signed amendment, initial cleared wire, card on file as fallback. Recommend suspension if an installment is missed by 10 days. Interest waiver needs CFO approval. Also request POP for the wire.

leo-legal: Ill draft the amendment with auto-charge fallback and explicit suspension triggers. Will include signature blocks for AM + client CFO. Who will own gathering signatures?

payment-bot: Notice: last automated dunning email to billing@nebula-analytics.com failed (mailbox full) at 2026-03-20T11:02:00Z.

cfo: OK to waive interest conditionally: initial $15k must clear and amendment executed within 72 hours of initial payment. Finance to confirm cleared funds before removing fees.

eva-finance: Ill assemble the schedule and draft amendment link: https://console.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-221/amendment — targeting to send by EOD.

diane-am: Client says they can wire $15k today and will send SWIFT remittance + signed PO. Ill upload POP when received.

anjali-collections: Add a technical remediation clause to the amendment: if any installment is missed, we will apply a temporary throughput cap on Dedicated (reduce worker pool by up to 40% for 48h) while keeping customer-facing endpoints online. This gives margin without full suspension. Approve?

marco-cs: Client reviewed throttle clause and accepted it as a compromise.

payment-bot: Alert: incoming wire notice received (remittance pending) at 2026-03-24T08:07:22Z.

eva-finance: Marking INV-2026-221 as "payment plan pending" until funds clear. Will not escalate to collections while initial payment is in transit.

leo-legal: Draft uploaded and shared for signature. Please cc finance@redwood-inference.com on executed copy.

diane-am: Uploaded signed PDF from client execs to the doc thread and emailed POP.
